sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她的头部被砍下，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查清了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是罪案档案推介（Casefile Presents）的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: From a young age, Kirstie Jones was sure of one thing.
sentences.zh: 从小时候起，基斯蒂·琼斯（Kirstie Jones）就坚信一件事。

sentences.en: She wanted to see as much of the world as possible.
sentences.zh: 她想尽可能多地去看看这个世界。

sentences.en: At 14, she decided that after finishing high school, she'd leave her family's 300-acre farm
sentences.zh: 14岁时，她就决定高中毕业后要离开家里那座占地300英亩的农场

sentences.en: just outside the small Welsh village of Tridoman and spend a year travelling around Australia.
sentences.zh: ——该农场位于威尔士小村庄特里多曼（Tridoman）郊外——然后花一年时间在澳大利亚各地旅行。

sentences.en: In 1996, 18-year-old Kirstie did just that.
sentences.zh: 1996年，18岁的基斯蒂付诸了行动。

sentences.en: She met her travel companion through a classified ad in her local newspaper, and off they went.
sentences.zh: 她通过当地报纸上的分类广告找到了旅伴，随后便出发了。

sentences.en: While Kirstie's parents, Sue and Glyn Jones, were naturally worried, they supported their daughter's wanderluSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然基斯蒂的父母苏（Sue）和格林·琼斯（Glyn Jones）难免会担心，但他们支持女儿对远方的好奇与渴望。

sentences.en: Kirstie was a vibrant, smart, and independent young woman who craved adventure and new experiences.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂是一个充满活力、聪明且独立的年轻女性，渴望冒险和新的体验。

sentences.en: They knew there was no point trying to hold her back.
sentences.zh: 他们知道试图阻拦她是毫无意义的。

sentences.en: The gap year in Australia was transformative for Kirstie.
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚的间隔年对基斯蒂来说具有变革性的意义。

sentences.en: Her parents remarked that she left Wales as a child and came home an adult.
sentences.zh: 她的父母评价说，她离开威尔士时还是个孩子，回家时已是一个成年人。

sentences.en: Her rich scratched for the time being, Kirstie spent the next couple of years at Liverpool
sentences.zh: 暂时满足了对远方的渴望后，基斯蒂在利物浦大学度过了接下来的几年

sentences.en: University completing a double degree in English and media studies.
sentences.zh: 攻读英语和媒体研究的双学位。

sentences.en: But her next adventure was never far from her mind.
sentences.zh: 但她对下一次冒险的想法从未从脑海中淡去。

sentences.en: While studying, Kirstie spent her spare time working two jobs to fund her next trip.
sentences.zh: 求学期间，基斯蒂利用业余时间打两份工，为下一次旅行攒钱。

sentences.en: This time she'd set her sights on something bigger.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她的目标更加宏大。

sentences.en: Kirstie planned to spend two years backpacking solo through Asia, Australia, New Zealand, and
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂计划花两年时间，独自背包游历亚洲、澳大利亚、新西兰和

sentences.en: South America.
sentences.zh: 南美洲。

sentences.en: She felt it was something she had to get out of her system.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这是她必须完成的心愿。

sentences.en: After that, she promised her parents she'd settle down.
sentences.zh: 之后，她向父母保证会安定下来。

sentences.en: While Sue and Glyn Jones had their reservations about Kirstie travelling alone, they weren't as worried this time around.
sentences.zh: 尽管苏和格林·琼斯对基斯蒂独自旅行有所保留，但这一次他们没有那么担心了。

sentences.en: 23-year-old Kirstie was older, wiser, and more experienced than when she'd left on her gap year, and they were proud of her for following her dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 23岁的基斯蒂比她开始间隔年旅行时年龄更大、更成熟、更有经验，他们为她追逐梦想感到骄傲。

sentences.en: They also knew she wouldn't be alone for long.
sentences.zh: 他们也知道她不会孤单太久。

sentences.en: Not only did she have plans to meet up with her best friend and boyfriend along the way,
sentences.zh: 她不仅计划在途中与最好的朋友和男友会合，

sentences.en: but people were naturally drawn to the confident and outgoing Kirstie, and it wouldn't be long before she'd connect with other backpackers.
sentences.zh: 而且自信外向的基斯蒂天然地吸引着身边的人，用不了多久她就会结识其他背包客。

sentences.en: Technology had also come a long way since Kirstie's gap year travels, and this time she'd be able to keep in touch with her family via email and video calls.
sentences.zh: 而且，自基斯蒂的间隔年旅行以来，科技已经有了长足的发展，这一次她能够通过电子邮件和视频通话与家人保持联系。

sentences.en: Kirstie set off for her trip in May 2000.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂于2000年5月踏上了旅程。

sentences.en: She ventured through Singapore and Malaysia for several weeks before reaching Thailand.
sentences.zh: 她在新加坡和马来西亚游历了数周，然后抵达泰国。

sentences.en: She'd been looking forward to this ever since she'd first visited the Land of Smiles on her way home from Australia a few years earlier.
sentences.zh: 自从几年前从澳大利亚回程途中首次访问这个“微笑之国”以来，她一直对这里充满期待。

sentences.en: Kirstie spent some time in the hustle and bustle of Bangkok before heading north to Chiang Mai for a change of pace.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂在熙熙攘攘的曼谷停留了一段时间，然后向北前往清迈，转换一下生活节奏。

sentences.en: Located 700 kilometres north of Bangkok in the Thai Highlands, Chiang Mai is a favourite
sentences.zh: 清迈位于曼谷以北700公里的泰国高地，是背包客们的最爱，

sentences.en: among backpackers who were drawn by the laid-back lifestyle, Buddhist temples, thriving nightlife, and affordability of the mountain city.
sentences.zh: 他们被这座山城的悠闲生活方式、佛教寺庙、繁荣的夜生活以及高性价比所吸引。

sentences.en: Following Thailand's economic collapse in 1997, Westerners could make their money stretch a long
sentences.zh: 在1997年泰国经济崩溃之后，西方人在清迈的钱非常经花，

sentences.en: way in Chiang Mai, with as little as three British pounds affording you an authentic Thai meal and beer at a restaurant with a view over the Meiping River.
sentences.zh: 只需区区3英镑左右，就能在一家能俯瞰湄平河（Meiping River）景致的餐厅里享用正宗的泰国大餐和啤酒。

sentences.en: Sue and Glyn Jones loved getting email updates from Kirstie.
sentences.zh: 苏和格林·琼斯非常喜欢收到基斯蒂发来的电子邮件。

sentences.en: After a week in Chiang Mai, she regaled them with stories about her three-day trek in the
sentences.zh: 在清迈呆了一周后，她向他们讲述了自己在梅切姆山（Meichem Mountain）地区进行为期三天徒步旅行的故事，

sentences.en: Meichem Mountain region, where she'd rode elephants and visited native hill tribes.
sentences.zh: 在那里她骑了大象并拜访了当地的山地部落。

sentences.en: Kirstie had only been gone for two months, but already it was shaping up to be the adventure of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂离开才两个月，但这趟旅程已经注定将是一次难忘的终身冒险。

sentences.en: In August 2000, Sue and Glyn travelled to Spain with two of their friends to celebrate their 25-year wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 2000年8月，苏和格林与两位朋友前往西班牙庆祝他们结婚25周年。

sentences.en: On the evening of Thursday August 10, they were getting ready for dinner when there was a knock at the door of their hotel room.
sentences.zh: 8月10日星期四傍晚，他们正准备吃晚饭，突然酒店房间的门被敲响了。

sentences.en: Their friends were standing there, looking devastated.
sentences.zh: 他们的朋友站在门外，神情悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: They told Sue and Glyn they'd just seen something shocking on the news.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉苏和格林，他们刚刚在新闻上看到了一个令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: It was around 4.30pm on the afternoon of Thursday August 10, 2000, when police scanners around Chiang Mai buzzed with the grim announcement.
sentences.zh: 2000年8月10日星期四下午4点半左右，清迈各地的警方无线电扫描器中传出了那条令人毛骨悚然的广播。

sentences.en: A cleaner at a local hostel had just entered the room of 23-year-old Kirstie Jones, only to discover a horrific scene.
sentences.zh: 当地一家旅社的一名清洁工刚走进23岁基斯蒂·琼斯的房间，就发现了一幕可怕的场景。

sentences.en: The young backpacker was lying face down on the bed, naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 这位年轻的背包客面朝下趴在床上，腰部以下一丝不挂。

sentences.en: A sarong was tied tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 一条沙龙（sarong）紧紧系在她的脖子上。

sentences.en: Police rushed to the crime scene, a two-storey building called the Aree Guesthouse and Massage
sentences.zh: 警察冲向案发现场，那是一栋名为阿里宾馆兼按摩学校（Aree Guesthouse and Massage School）的两层建筑。

sentences.en: School.
sentences.zh: “阿里”具有当地的典型特色。

sentences.en: The Aree was typical of the area.
sentences.zh: 它位于清迈市中心众多狭窄的小巷之一，为背包客和经济型旅客提供简朴的住宿，单人房每晚价格约为1英镑，经济实惠。

sentences.en: Located on one of downtown Chiang Mai's many narrow laneways, it offered backpackers and budget travellers a no-frills place to stay at the affordable rate of around £1 a night
sentences.zh: 这家拥有九间客房的旅馆的住客可以在绿树成荫的小花园和露天酒吧里社交，房东还在二楼经营一家按摩学校。

sentences.en: for a single room.
sentences.zh: 这家拥有九间客房的旅馆的住客可以在绿树成荫的小花园和露天酒吧里社交，房东还在二楼经营一家按摩学校。

sentences.en: Guests of the nine-room lodging could mingle in the small shady garden and open-air bar, while the owners also ran a massage school from the second floor.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂选择“阿里”作为她在清迈逗留期间的落脚点。

sentences.en: Kirstie had chosen the Aree as her home base during her stay in Chiang Mai.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂选择“阿里”作为她在清迈逗留期间的落脚点。

sentences.en: Officers made their way down the hallway and into her bedroom on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 警官们穿过走廊，进入她位于一楼的卧室。

sentences.en: It was a basic room, containing nothing more than a rickety double bed with an old wooden dresser and a tabletop fan.
sentences.zh: 这是一间简陋的房间，里面除了摆着一张吱呀作响的双人床、一个旧木梳妆台和一个桌面电风扇外，别无他物。

sentences.en: A thin mattress adorned with a bright floral pattern sat atop the bed, while cheap floral curtains hung haphazardly from the window that overlooked the hallway.
sentences.zh: 床铺上铺着一张带有明亮花卉图案的薄床垫，窗户上挂着廉价的花布窗帘，凌乱地俯瞰着走廊。

sentences.en: By the time police entered the room, they were not the first ones there.
sentences.zh: 当警察进入房间时，他们并不是第一批到达那里的人。

sentences.en: Tipped off by the local police scanner, an entire television crew had already arrived and taken footage and photos of the scene, while curious onlookers peered in.
sentences.zh: 在当地警用扫描器的通风报信下，一整支电视摄制组已经赶到，并对现场进行了拍摄和取景，好奇的旁观者也探头张望。

sentences.en: As police began assessing the room, they didn't stop to seal off the crime scene, and reporters and photographers continued to trickle in.
sentences.zh: 随着警察开始评估房间情况，他们并没有停下来封锁案发现场，记者和摄影师源源不断地涌入。

sentences.en: Local journalist Pim Kemasinki was among them.
sentences.zh: 当地记者皮姆·凯马辛基（Pim Kemasinki）就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Writing for Chiang Mai publication City Life, she later recalled that around 20 people had entered Kirstie's room before any forensic evidence had even been collected.
sentences.zh: 她后来在为清迈出版物《城市生活》（City Life）撰文时回忆说，在收集任何法医证据之前，大约已有20人进入了基斯蒂的房间。

sentences.en: Some reporters rummaged through Kirstie's clothes and toiletry bag, one of them tutting in judgment as he held up a packet of condoMs.
sentences.zh: 一些记者翻找了基斯蒂的衣服和洗漱包，其中一人举起一包安全套，发出一声评头论足的啧啧声。

sentences.en: One camera operator even turned Kirstie's head from side to side to get the shot they wanted.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一名摄像师为了拍到想要的镜头，把基斯蒂的头左右扭转。

sentences.en: None of the police officers present seemed even remotely concerned.
sentences.zh: 在场的警察似乎一点也不在意。

sentences.en: Not only had the crime scene been severely compromised, another problem for the police was that they
sentences.zh: 案发现场不仅遭到严重破坏，警方面临的另一个问题是，

sentences.en: couldn't find a forensic pathologist who was available to come to the Arie guesthouse to examine Kirstie's body.
sentences.zh: 他们找不到愿意赶到阿里宾馆检查基斯蒂尸体的法医病理学家。

sentences.en: Instead, her body was eventually taken to the Chiang Mai Hospital, where an autopsy determined that she had died from asphyxiation.
sentences.zh: 相反，她的遗体最终被运往清迈医院，经尸检确定她死于窒息。

sentences.en: Severe internal bruising indicated she'd been violently raped.
sentences.zh: 严重的内部淤伤表明她曾遭受暴力强奸。

sentences.en: Seamen found in her body gave the police the confidence that her killer would be promptly found and brought to justice.
sentences.zh: 在她体内发现的精液让警方坚信，凶手很快就会被找到并绳之以法。

sentences.en: Straight off the bat, police were convinced that Kirstie had been killed by someone she knew.
sentences.zh: 警方一开局就确信基斯蒂是被她认识的人杀害的。

sentences.en: Her room was located inside the guesthouse and could be padlocked from both the inside and outside.
sentences.zh: 她的房间位于宾馆内部，可以从里外两侧加挂挂锁。

sentences.en: There were no signs of forced entry, which led the police to believe that Kirstie might have invited the perpetrator inside.
sentences.zh: 现场没有强行闯入的迹象，这让警方认为基斯蒂可能是主动邀请凶手进屋的。

sentences.en: They were also convinced the killer had been a farang, the Thai word for a foreigner.
sentences.zh: 他们还确信凶手是一名“法朗”（farang），即泰语中对外国人的称呼。

sentences.en: Kirstie had been sodomised, which they reasoned was a sexual act that Thai men didn't engage in.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂遭到肛交，他们推断这是泰国男性不会参与的性行为。

sentences.en: The most obvious explanation for the police was that the killer had also been staying at the
sentences.zh: 对警方来说，最显而易见的解释是凶手也住在阿里宾馆。

sentences.en: Arie guesthouse.
sentences.zh: 虽然该旅社的廉价收费吸引了来自世界各地的背包客，但也招徕了一些形迹可疑的顾客。

sentences.en: While the cheap rates of the hostel drew in backpackers from all over the world, it also attracted some dubious customers.
sentences.zh: 虽然该旅社的廉价收费吸引了来自世界各地的背包客，但也招徕了一些形迹可疑的顾客。

sentences.en: Thailand has long been known as a destination for those looking to escape their lives back
sentences.zh: 长期以来，泰国一直是那些想要逃离国内生活的人的目的地，尽管该国实行严格的禁毒法律，但在清迈很容易买到违禁药物。

sentences.en: home, and despite the country's strict anti-drug laws, illicit drugs were readily available in Chiang Mai.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，泰国一直是那些想要逃离国内生活的人的目的地，尽管该国实行严格的禁毒法律，但在清迈很容易买到违禁药物。

sentences.en: One French backpacker told The Guardian,
sentences.zh: 一名法国背包客告诉《卫报》（The Guardian），

sentences.en: The year before Kirstie Jones was murdered, the Arie guesthouse had been closed down for six months after one of its guests died of a heroin overdose.
sentences.zh: 在基斯蒂·琼斯被谋杀的前一年，阿里宾馆曾因一名住客吸食海洛因过量死亡而被勒令停业六个月。

sentences.en: Given this ill repute, police were certain that they'd find Kirstie's killer among the Arie's clientele.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这种声誉狼藉，警方确信他们会在阿里的顾客中找到基斯蒂的凶手。

sentences.en: One by one, each of the guests were taken to the city's main police station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 房客们被一个接一个带到市警察局接受讯问。

sentences.en: 27-year-old Nathan Foley was an Australian backpacker who had stopped over in Thailand on his way to visit relatives in the UK.
sentences.zh: 27岁的内森·福利（Nathan Foley）是一名澳大利亚背包客，他在去英国探亲的途中在泰国作了短暂停留。

sentences.en: He'd met Kirstie at the Arie and the two had got chatting.
sentences.zh: 他在阿里宾馆遇到了基斯蒂，两人便聊了起来。

sentences.en: Both solo travellers, Nathan was thankful to have someone to talk to and the pair had explored the city together.
sentences.zh: 两人都是独自旅行者，内森很庆幸能有人说话，于是两人一起探索了这座城市。

sentences.en: Nathan told the police that on the evening of Wednesday August 9, the night before Kirstie
sentences.zh: 内森告诉警方，在8月9日星期三晚上——也就是基斯蒂被杀的前一晚，他和基斯蒂以及一位名叫莎拉·威格特（Sarah Wiggett）的英国背包客一起去当地一家餐厅吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: was killed, he'd gone out to dinner at a local restaurant with Kirstie and a British backpacker named Sarah Wiggett.
sentences.zh: 内森告诉警方，在8月9日星期三晚上——也就是基斯蒂被杀的前一晚，他和基斯蒂以及一位名叫莎拉·威格特（Sarah Wiggett）的英国背包客一起去当地一家餐厅吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: Nathan claimed that he'd left Kirstie and Sarah at about 10pm and went back to the Arie where he'd taken a couple of sleeping pills and gone straight to sleep.
sentences.zh: 内森声称，他在晚上10点左右离开基斯蒂和莎拉，回到了阿里宾馆，吃了两粒安眠药后就直接睡了。

sentences.en: Sarah Wiggett wasn't staying at the Arie but at a different hostel nearby.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·威格特并没有住在阿里，而是住在附近另一家旅社。

sentences.en: Police tracked her down and brought her in for questioning.
sentences.zh: 警方找到了她并带她回来接受讯问。

sentences.en: Sarah was horrified to hear what had happened to Kirstie.
sentences.zh: 听到基斯蒂遭遇不测，莎拉感到震惊万分。

sentences.en: The two had met on a three-day trekking trip which had ended just two days prior and they'd bonded over their shared experiences as solo female travellers.
sentences.zh: 两人是在一次为期三天的徒步旅行中结识的，那次旅行仅仅在两天前才结束，作为独自旅行的女性，她们有着共同的经历，因此感情很深。

sentences.en: Sarah told the police that after Nathan Foley left the previous evening, she and Kirstie visited the night markets, which were about a 25-minute walk from the Arie.
sentences.zh: 莎拉告诉警方，在前一天晚上内森·福利离开后，她和基斯蒂去了夜市，夜市距离阿里步行大约25分钟。

sentences.en: They strolled around until about 11pm, by which point Sarah had had enough of shopping and was ready to go back to her hostel.
sentences.zh: 她们闲逛到晚上11点左右，此时莎拉已经逛够了，准备回她的旅社。

sentences.en: Kirstie stayed on, saying she had some more presents she wanted to buy.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂留了下来，说她还有一些想买的礼物。

sentences.en: Another long-term Arie resident, Stephen Trigg, told the police that at around 1am, he'd heard a commotion coming from Kirstie's room.
sentences.zh: 另一位阿里的长期住客斯蒂芬·特里格（Stephen Trigg）告诉警方，大约凌晨1点，他听到基斯蒂的房间里传出骚动。

sentences.en: It sounded like a woman was screaming, get out, get out, leave me alone.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一个女人在尖叫：“滚出去，滚出去，离我远点。”

sentences.en: Stephen claimed he went to investigate, but the screaming stopped, so he went back to bed, assuming it had been nothing more than a lover's tiff.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬声称他前去查看，但尖叫声停了，于是他回到了床上，以为这不过是一场情侣间的吵闹。

sentences.en: Stephen was a seasoned traveller who had been staying at the Arie for several months.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬是一位经验丰富的旅行者，已经在阿里住了几个月。

sentences.en: He said it was common to overhear these types of arguments and they didn't usually result in any probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他说，偶尔听到这类争吵是很常见的，通常不会导致任何问题。

sentences.en: The Arie's tyre manager, 47-year-old Surin Chanpranat, lived upstairs and also ran the massage school there.
sentences.zh: 阿里的轮胎经理、47岁的苏林·钱普拉纳特（Surin Chanpranat）住在楼上，同时也在那里经营按摩学校。

sentences.en: A known drug dealer, he had been arrested twice before for possession of heroin.
sentences.zh: 作为一个众所周知的毒贩，他以前曾因藏有海洛因被捕过两次。

sentences.en: Surin told the police that he too had heard the screams coming from Kirstie's room.
sentences.zh: 苏林告诉警察，他也听到了从基斯蒂房间里传出的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Surin said he'd been in the shower at the time and had gone downstairs to Kirstie's room with Stephen Trigg to investigate.
sentences.zh: 苏林说他当时正在洗澡，听到声音后便和斯蒂芬·特里格一起下楼到基斯蒂的房间查看。

sentences.en: He pressed his ear to the door, but heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 他把耳朵贴在门上，但什么也没听到。

sentences.en: Not wanting to invade a guest's privacy, he went back to bed and told Stephen to do the same.
sentences.zh: 由于不想侵犯客人的隐私，他回到了床上，并叫斯蒂芬也这样做。

sentences.en: Kirstie's autopsy confirmed that she had been killed around the same time the screams were heard coming from her room.
sentences.zh: 基斯蒂的尸检证实，她遇害的时间与听到从她房间传出尖叫声的时间大致相同。

sentences.en: With Sarah Wiggett being the last person to see her alive at 11pm, police deduced that Kirstie
sentences.zh: 由于莎拉·威格特是晚上11点最后看到她还活着的人，警方推断基斯蒂大约在午夜时分回到了宾馆，并在返回后的一小时内遇害。

sentences.en: had likely returned to the guest house at around midnight and was killed within an hour of returning.
sentences.zh: 由于莎拉·威格特是晚上11点最后看到她还活着的人，警方推断基斯蒂大约在午夜时分回到了宾馆，并在返回后的一小时内遇害。

sentences.en: They didn't know if she had walked the 25-minute route home from the markets or caught a local taxi known as a tuk-tuk.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道她是步行25分钟从市场走回来的，还是搭乘了被称为“嘟嘟车”（tuk-tuk）的当地出租车。

sentences.en: A search of the Arie's manager Surin Chanpranat's room revealed cannabis and amphetamines and he was placed under arrest for possession.
sentences.zh: 对阿里经理苏林·钱普拉纳特房间的搜查发现了他藏有的大麻和安非他命，他因涉嫌藏毒被捕。

sentences.en: Suspicion that Surin could have been involved in Kirstie's murder was raised when a postcard was found in his room that featured a white woman tied up in bondage.
sentences.zh: 当在他的房间里发现一张印有被绑缚白人女性画面的明信片时，警方对苏林可能卷入基斯蒂谋杀案的怀疑加剧了。

sentences.en: But Surin's girlfriend, Pantipa, who also lived at the Arie, supported Surin's story.
sentences.zh: 但苏林的女友潘蒂帕（Pantipa）也住在阿里，她为苏林作证。

sentences.en: She said that he'd been in their room all night except for when he heard the noise coming from Kirstie's room and went downstairs to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 她说他整晚都待在房间里，除了听到基斯蒂房间有动静而下楼查看情况的那一次例外。

sentences.en: Police were also highly suspicious of 28-year-old Stuart Crichton, another Australian man who had also been staying at the Arie for several months.
sentences.zh: 警方对28岁的斯图尔特·克里希顿（Stuart Crichton）也高度怀疑，这名澳大利亚男子也在阿里住了几个月。

sentences.en: A known heroin user with a history of street fighting,
sentences.zh: 他是一个有街头斗殴史的惯习海洛因吸食者，

sentences.en: Stuart claimed to have no knowledge of Kirstie Jones' murder.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特声称对基斯蒂·琼斯的谋杀一无所知。

sentences.en: Yet, a search of his room turned up cannabis and heroin, prompting police to also place him under arrest for possession.
sentences.zh: 然而，对他的房间进行搜查起出了大麻和海洛因，促使警方同样以藏毒罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: Another long-term Arie resident also proved to be a dubious figure after he claimed to be a former Mormon elder and CIA spy who had come to Thailand to recover from a head injury.
sentences.zh: 阿里的另一位长期住客也被证明是一个可疑人物，他自称是前摩门教长老和中情局间谍，来泰国是为了从头部受伤中恢复。

sentences.en: While none of the questioning resulted in an arrest for Kirstie Jones' murder, the police remained convinced that she had known her killer.
sentences.zh: 虽然所有这些讯问都没有导致任何人因谋杀基斯蒂·琼斯而被捕，但警方仍然坚信她认识凶手。

sentences.en: They considered the possibility that Kirstie could have invited the perpetrator into her room where she'd then refused his sexual advances.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑了这样一种可能性：基斯蒂可能邀请凶手进入她的房间，随后拒绝了对方的性要求。

sentences.en: Feeling rejected, he could have turned violent and launched an attack.
sentences.zh: 由于感到遭到拒绝，凶手可能情绪失控并发动了袭击。

sentences.en: The senior investigating officer put forward a controversial theory when he publicly suggested that Kirstie could have engaged in consensual sex
sentences.zh: 高级调查警官提出了一个极具争议的理论，他在公开场合暗示基斯蒂可能进行了自愿性行为，

sentences.en: and had been strangled to death by accident.
sentences.zh: 并且是在意外中被人勒死的。

sentences.en: This comment not only deeply upset Kirstie's already heartbroken family, but added further criticism to the investigation which had been receiving widespread media attention
sentences.zh: 这一言论不仅深深伤害了基斯蒂本已心碎的家人，还让自记者抵达案发现场以来一直备受公众关注的调查工作面临更多指责。

sentences.en: from the moment reporters arrived at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 这一言论不仅深深伤害了基斯蒂本已心碎的家人，还让自记者抵达案发现场以来一直备受公众关注的调查工作面临更多指责。

sentences.en: This theory led suspicion to fall on Nathan Foley, the Australian man Kirstie had dinner with the night before she died.
sentences.zh: 这一理论让嫌疑落在了内森·福利身上，也就是基斯蒂遇害前一晚与她共进晚餐的那名澳大利亚男子。

sentences.en: Not only had they spent the most time together, but after Kirstie's body was found, it had taken police a few hours to track Nathan down,
sentences.zh: 他们不仅在一起的时间最长，而且在基斯蒂的尸体被发现后，警方花了几个小时才找到内森，

sentences.en: leading them to wonder if he was trying to hide.
sentences.zh: 这让他们怀疑他是否在试图躲藏。

sentences.en: But Nathan Foley adamantly denied having anything to do with the crime or having any romantic interest in Kirstie.
sentences.zh: 但内森·福利坚决否认自己与这起犯罪有任何关系，也否认对基斯蒂有任何浪漫的想法。

sentences.en: With no evidence or witnesses to suggest otherwise, he was free to leave the station.
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据或目击者表明相反的情况，他被允许离开警局。

sentences.en: But the prospect of facing the overly zealous press was too daunting.
sentences.zh: 但面对过分狂热的媒体的前景实在是令人望而生畏。

sentences.en: The phone at the police station had been ringing non-stop.
sentences.zh: 警察局里的电话一直在响个不停。

sentences.en: Kirstie's travel buddy, Sarah Wiggett, later recalled to Murder in Paradise that while she was waiting to be interviewed, one officer had handed her the phone and said,
sentences.zh: 克丝蒂的旅伴莎拉·威格特后来在《天堂谋杀案》节目中回忆说，当时她正等着接受盘问，一名警官突然把电话递给她并说道：

sentences.en: it's for you.
sentences.zh: 找你的。

sentences.en: It's the press office wanting to find out what happened.
sentences.zh: 是新闻办公室打来的，想了解到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Sarah was stunned.
sentences.zh: 莎拉惊呆了。

sentences.en: She hadn't even given her account to law enforcement at that point, yet they were already encouraging her to speak to the media.
sentences.zh: 当时她甚至还没向警方提供口供，警方就已经在鼓励她和媒体对话了。

sentences.en: Aware of the attention the case was receiving already,
sentences.zh: 意识到这起案件已经引发了广泛关注，

sentences.en: Nathan Foley opted to remain in police custody, where he requested protection.
sentences.zh: 内森·弗利选择留在警察局拘留所，并要求获得警方保护。

sentences.en: He, along with all of the Aree's other male residents, were required to provide DNA samples for testing.
sentences.zh: 他和阿里旅馆的所有其他男性住客一样，都被要求提供DNA样本进行检测。

sentences.en: While investigators waited for the results, immigration authorities were alerted to stop any of the suspects from leaving the country.
sentences.zh: 在调查人员等待结果的同时，移民部门接到警报，以阻止任何嫌疑人离境。

sentences.en: One investigator told the press that, while they didn't know exactly what happened, they were certain one of the Aree guests or staff members were responsible.
sentences.zh: 一名调查人员对媒体表示，虽然他们还不知道具体发生了什么，但他们确信是阿里旅馆的某位住客或工作人员干的。

sentences.en: Kirstie knew her killer, he stated.
sentences.zh: 他声称，克丝蒂认识凶手。

sentences.en: We are confident we will make an arrest in 7 to 10 days.
sentences.zh: 我们有信心在7到10天内实施逮捕。

sentences.en: There was one resident of the Aree guesthouse who was noticeably absent.
sentences.zh: 阿里旅馆有一名住客却不见了踪影。

sentences.en: 32-year-old Andy Gill was a British man who had been living in Thailand on and off for the past 12 years.
sentences.zh: 32岁的安迪·吉尔是一名英国人，过去12年里断断续续地住在泰国。

sentences.en: A well-known character among Chiang Mai's expat community,
sentences.zh: 他是清迈外籍人士圈子里颇有名气的人物，

sentences.en: Andy had once been married to a Thai woman and the two had a child together.
sentences.zh: 安迪曾与一名泰国女子结过婚，两人育有一子。

sentences.en: Two years before Kirstie's murder,
sentences.zh: 在克丝蒂遇害两年前，

sentences.en: Andy had taken over ownership of the Aree after its Thai owner moved overseas.
sentences.zh: 在阿里旅馆的泰国老板移居海外后，安迪接管了这家旅馆。

sentences.en: Curiously, when Kirstie's body was discovered,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，当克丝蒂的尸体被发现时，

sentences.en: Andy was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 安迪却不见踪影。

sentences.en: It took the police two days before they finally tracked Andy Gill down at a local bar.
sentences.zh: 警方花了了两天时间，才终于在当地一家酒吧找到了安迪·吉尔。

sentences.en: He claimed that on the night of Kirstie's murder, he hadn't been at the guesthouse.
sentences.zh: 他声称在克丝蒂遇害当晚，他根本不在旅馆。

sentences.en: He'd been out with a Thai friend who could vouch for his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 他和一个能为他证明行踪的泰国朋友出去了。

sentences.en: But a quick background check on Andy revealed that he was actually in Thailand illegally, having overstayed his visa by two years.
sentences.zh: 但对安迪的背景进行快速调查后发现，他其实是个非法滞留泰国的黑户，签证已经逾期两年。

sentences.en: For this offence, he was promptly placed under arrest and given a small fine.
sentences.zh: 因为这一违法行为，他随即被捕并被处以少量罚款。

sentences.en: With three of the Aree residents under arrest for offences unrelated to Kirstie's murder, the story quickly became a media sensation, both in Thailand and overseas.
sentences.zh: 随着阿里旅馆的三名住客因与克丝蒂谋杀案无关的罪行被捕，这起案件迅速成为泰国乃至海外轰动一时的新闻。

sentences.en: Not only did the case include a cast of colourful characters whose faces were splashed across the news, but it touched on the worst fears of every parent
sentences.zh: 这起案件不仅汇集了一群个性鲜明、频频登上新闻头条的人物，还触动了所有父母内心深处最恐惧的神经——

sentences.en: whose children were off backpacking in foreign lands.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子孤身一人在异国他乡背包旅行。

sentences.en: Dozens of journalists from major media outlets converged in Chiang Mai, speaking to anyone who was willing to talk.
sentences.zh: 来自各大主流媒体的数十名记者涌向清迈，采访任何愿意开口的人。

sentences.en: Back in Wales,
sentences.zh: 远在威尔士，

sentences.en: Kirstie's family struggled to come to terms with it all.
sentences.zh: 克丝蒂的家人艰难地接受着这一切。

sentences.en: Her parents, Sue and Glyn, returned from their wedding anniversary trip to Spain immediately after hearing the news.
sentences.zh: 她的父母苏和格林在听到消息后，立刻中断了在西班牙的结婚纪念旅行赶了回来。

sentences.en: Utterly devastated, the pair remained under sedation at their family home.
sentences.zh: 两人悲痛欲绝，一直在家中靠镇静剂度日。

sentences.en: Kirstie's 21-year-old brother,
sentences.zh: 克丝蒂21岁的弟弟，

sentences.en: Gareth, had been out driving the tractor on the family farm when he heard the news about Kirstie's murder on the radio.
sentences.zh: 加雷斯当时正在家族农场里开着拖拉机，从收音机里听到了克丝蒂遇害的消息。

sentences.en: He told British newspaper The Independent,
sentences.zh: 他告诉英国《独立报》，

sentences.en: I just cannot believe what has happened.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信发生了这种事。

sentences.en: At the moment,
sentences.zh: 目前，

sentences.en: I'm just pretending Kirstie is still away on holiday and will eventually come back.
sentences.zh: 我只能假装克丝蒂还在外面度假，最终会回来的。

sentences.en: Kirstie's murder put Chiang Mai under the global spotlight for all the wrong reasons.
sentences.zh: 克丝蒂的遇害让清迈因种种负面原因成为了全球关注的焦点。

sentences.en: Like so much of Thailand,
sentences.zh: 就像泰国的许多地方一样，

sentences.en: Chiang Mai's economy relied heavily on tourism, not just from backpackers, but from travellers of all ages and backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 清迈的经济高度依赖旅游业，不仅有背包客，还有来自各年龄段和背景的游客。

sentences.en: With the intense scrutiny of the international press highlighting every misstep of the investigation and criticising the offensive theories shared by the police chief,
sentences.zh: 由于国际媒体的密切关注，大肆报道调查过程中的每一个失误，并批评警察局长发表的无理言论，

sentences.en: concerns were high about the negative impact the story would have on tourism.
sentences.zh: 人们高度担忧这一事件会给旅游业带来负面影响。

sentences.en: The pressure was on for the police to solve the case, faSt.
sentences.zh: 警方面临着迅速破案的巨大压力。

sentences.en: A few days into the investigation, they got the breakthrough they'd been hoping for when the cleaner who'd discovered Kirstie's body came forward to change her story.
sentences.zh: 调查进行几天后，发现克丝蒂尸体的清洁工主动改变了供词，这让他们迎来了期望已久的突破。

sentences.en: The cleaner had originally claimed that she'd found Kirstie's body at around 4.30 on the afternoon of Thursday, August 10.
sentences.zh: 这名清洁工最初声称，她是在8月10日星期四下午4点半左右发现克丝蒂尸体的。

sentences.en: But this had been a lie.
sentences.zh: 但这是个谎言。

sentences.en: She admitted that the discovery had actually been made at around 10.30am, and not by her, but by the ARI's owner,
sentences.zh: 她承认尸体其实是在上午10点半左右被发现的，发现者不是她，而是阿里旅馆的老板，

sentences.en: Andy Gill.
sentences.zh: 安迪·吉尔。

sentences.en: The cleaner told the police that Andy and the guesthouse manager,
sentences.zh: 清洁工告诉警方，安迪和旅馆经理，

sentences.en: Surin Champrenat, had asked her to hold off making the report for almost five hours while they dealt with some other issues.
sentences.zh: 素林·钱普雷纳特曾要求她延后近五个小时再报警，以便他们处理一些其他问题。

sentences.en: When questioned about this allegation,
sentences.zh: 当被问及这一指控时，

sentences.en: Andy Gill admitted it was true.
sentences.zh: 安迪·吉尔承认这是真的。

sentences.en: He claimed it was late on Thursday morning when Surin Champrenat approached him to say that there had been some commotion coming from Kirstie's room the night before.
sentences.zh: 他声称那是周四上午晚些时候，素林·钱普雷纳特找到他，说前一天晚上克丝蒂的房间里传出过一些喧闹声。

sentences.en: Andy asked if anyone had seen Kirstie yet.
sentences.zh: 安迪问是否有人见过克丝蒂。

sentences.en: Surin told him no, adding that her room was padlocked from the outside.
sentences.zh: 素林告诉他没有，并补充说她的房间从外面被挂上了挂锁。

sentences.en: According to Andy, his first thought was that Kirstie might have gotten in a fight with someone and had run away.
sentences.zh: 据安迪所说，他最初的想法是克丝蒂可能跟人吵架后离家出走了。

sentences.en: He wasn't worried that something bad might have happened to her.
sentences.zh: 他并不担心她会遭遇不测。

sentences.en: He was more worried that she had run off without paying her bill.
sentences.zh: 他更担心的是她没付房费就溜走了。

sentences.en: Andy had a spare key for the padlock, so he went and unlocked Kirstie's room, only to find her lying face down on the bed inside.
